t: Morninglord Character in Barovia | World Anvil
s: The main god of worship in Barovia. His holy symbol is depicted as a rising sun. Most Barovians pray daily for the Morninglord to save them from their torment, but the skies have remained cloudy and dark for over 700 years.

t: Lathander Character in The Forgotten Realms | World Anvil
s: Lathander, whose title was The Morninglord, was a deity of creativity, dawn, renewal, birth, athletics, spring, self-perfection, vitality, and youth. He favoured those who dispelled the undead and blessed those who planted new life.

t: Morninglord religion Organization in Barovia - Ravenloft | World Anvil
s: The Morninglord is one of two deities believed to watch over the land of Barovia, the other being Mother Night . The Morninglord is said to be the god of Dawn, Renewal, Life, Day, Healing, Spring, and many other concepts associated with the sun and positive energy.
